run_prepare_otb_dataset: run the script to download and merge AIME, HMMT, MATH-500, and OTB datasets into data/otb_full
run_merge_math_datasets: run the script to merge AIME 2025, HMMT Feb 2025, and MATH-500 math datasets into a single HuggingFace dataset
run_filter_overthinkingbench: run the script to filter the overthinkingbench subset to only include rows with 4 or fewer options
run_save_otb_full: run the script to save the merged and filtered optimal thinking benchmark dataset to disk as data/otb_full
run_combine_underthinking_overthinking: run the script to combine underthinking-math and overthinking-math subsets from multiple sources into one dataset
